blockedReasons.summary: No reviewed local redaction rule source exists.
Prompt, response, message, attachment, and clipboard content boundaries remain unavailable.
Transcript storage, retention, export, and redaction policy is not configured.
Detector scope, match handling, and replacement policy require review.
Redaction results are not persisted or exported.

handoffRefs.summary: Composer data keeps prompt capture and prompt redaction disabled.
Empty message-list data prevents message redaction.
Transcript persistence and export remain unavailable.
Attachment policy keeps attachment payload reads disabled.
Clipboard policy keeps clipboard payload reads and writes disabled.
Audit-event data keeps audit redaction and persistence disabled.
Local-only policy keeps provider, cloud, network, and upload paths unavailable.

limitations: Data-only chat redaction-policy fixture; no redaction rules, prompt, response, transcript, message body, attachment, clipboard data, audit content, file, artifact, model path, runtime log, or private path is read or written.

Content scanning, sensitive-content detection, prompt redaction, response redaction, transcript redaction, message redaction, attachment redaction, clipboard redaction, audit redaction, and result persistence remain disabled or blocked.
No PII, secret, token, path, identifier, or detector match is produced or included.
No model load, runtime execution, provider call, network call, upload, artifact access, or KV260 hardware access is performed.
This is not a release, tag, compatibility commitment, MCP, LSP, IDE, marketplace, telemetry, or runtime implementation.

redactionControls.label: review redaction rules
redactionControls.launcherAction: Keep rules unavailable and do not load policy files.
redactionControls.userAction: Review rules only after a separate local policy source is defined.

redactionControls.label: scan prompt content
redactionControls.launcherAction: Do not capture, inspect, or scan prompt text.
redactionControls.userAction: Scan prompts only after prompt capture and redaction review exists.

redactionControls.label: scan response content
redactionControls.launcherAction: Do not generate, inspect, or scan response text.
redactionControls.userAction: Scan responses only after a reviewed response stream exists.

redactionControls.label: scan transcript content
redactionControls.launcherAction: Do not read, export, inspect, or scan transcripts.
redactionControls.userAction: Scan transcripts only after local storage and retention policy exists.

redactionControls.label: detect sensitive content
redactionControls.launcherAction: Do not run PII, secret, token, path, or identifier detection.
redactionControls.userAction: Run detectors only after local detector scope and review rules exist.

redactionControls.label: redact attachment payload
redactionControls.launcherAction: Do not open, read, parse, scan, or redact file or artifact payloads.
redactionControls.userAction: Redact attachments only after file input, parsing, and redaction rules are reviewed.

redactionControls.label: redact clipboard payload
redactionControls.launcherAction: Do not read, scan, redact, import, or write clipboard data.
redactionControls.userAction: Redact clipboard data only after clipboard read and redaction boundaries are reviewed.

redactionControls.label: persist redaction result
redactionControls.launcherAction: Do not write redaction reports, artifacts, transcripts, or session records.
redactionControls.userAction: Persist redaction results only after local store and retention policy exists.

redactionPolicy.contentPolicy: redaction policy metadata only; no raw content, detector matches, replacement text, identifiers, file names, paths, bytes, prompts, responses, transcripts, or messages are included
redactionPolicy.sourcePolicy: checked fixture only; no prompt, response, transcript, message, attachment, clipboard, audit, session-store, file, artifact, model path, or runtime log is read

redactionSurfaces.label: composer prompt
redactionSurfaces.summary: Prompt redaction remains disabled because prompt capture is not enabled.

redactionSurfaces.label: assistant response
redactionSurfaces.summary: Response redaction remains disabled because no generated response exists.

redactionSurfaces.label: message list
redactionSurfaces.summary: Message redaction remains unavailable because message bodies are not captured.

redactionSurfaces.label: transcript export
redactionSurfaces.summary: Transcript redaction requires a reviewed store, retention, and export policy.

redactionSurfaces.label: attachment payload
redactionSurfaces.summary: Attachment redaction remains blocked until file and artifact input boundaries exist.

redactionSurfaces.label: clipboard payload
redactionSurfaces.summary: Clipboard redaction remains disabled because clipboard reads are unavailable.

redactionSurfaces.label: audit event
redactionSurfaces.summary: Audit redaction remains blocked because audit persistence is not configured.
